questions.cardDe: Was bedeutet „Monte Carlo“ ins Deutsche übersetzt?
questions.de: Was bedeutet „Monte Carlo“ ins Deutsche übersetzt?
questions.en: What does "Monte Carlo" mean when translated into German (English)?

timeline.labelEn: The area around Monaco's casino is named Monte-Carlo after Prince Charles III
timeline.labelDe: Das Gebiet um Monacos Spielbank erhält nach Fürst Charles III. den Namen Monte-Carlo

questions.notes: Italian monte = mountain, Carlo = Charles: named after Prince Charles III of Monaco, who founded the casino there in the 1860s.

questions.en: In which 1982 film did nearly 300,000 extras appear in the funeral scene – a record at the time?

timeline.labelEn: Filming of the funeral scene of Gandhi with nearly 300,000 extras, on the 33rd anniversary of the funeral
timeline.labelDe: Dreh der Begräbnisszene von Gandhi mit fast 300.000 Statisten am 33. Jahrestag der Beisetzung

questions.notes: Multiple-choice options removed (Ben Hur, Braveheart, Gandhi). Richard Attenborough's Gandhi; about 200,000 of the extras were unpaid volunteers.

questions.de: Wie heißt das skandinavische Land, in dem die Büroklammer 1940 zum Symbol für Königstreue und Widerstand gegen die Besatzungsmacht wurde?
questions.en: What is the name of the Scandinavian country in which the paper clip became a symbol of loyalty to the king and resistance against the occupying power in 1940?

timeline.labelEn: German occupation of Norway in the Second World War
timeline.labelDe: Deutsche Besetzung Norwegens im Zweiten Weltkrieg

questions.notes: Norwegian patriots wore paper clips on their lapels when pins with King Haakon VII's cipher were banned.
